fusions.name: Palmed Dose
fusions.desc: A weapon strike with musk smeared across your palm that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Wafted Their Way
fusions.desc: Fans musk with an open hand across a cone 3 tiles long that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hold Your Nose
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you and your allies, and restores 8 health to you.

fusions.name: Grip That Won't Wash
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.
